data: CLKC-56
Advisory
MMCME4 with global clock driver has no LOC

The MMCME4_ADV cell <cell: g_ethernet.u_compute_clock/inst/mmcme4_adv_inst> CLKIN1 or CLKIN2 pin is driven by global Clock buffer(s) <cell: u_ddr4/inst/u_ddr4_infrastructure/u_bufg_divClk> and does not have a LOC constraint. It is recommended to LOC the MMCM and use the CLOCK_DEDICATED_ROUTE constraint on the net(s) driven by the global Clock buffer(s).
